description: Caller volunteers a comfortable budget. Stays Green; the AI never echoes the figure.

turns: Good morning, this is Rahul. We have a 3BHK in Aundh, around 1,100 sq ft, and want a complete redesign including flooring and the kitchen.
We've kept aside a comfortable budget, about twenty-five lakh, so that's not a concern.
We'd like it all done by April.
Yes, my wife and I both decide.
